lines.say: Here is an equation.
Two things have been done to x.
First x was multiplied by 4.
Then 7 was added.
Two things done to x. So we call it a two-step equation.
Our job is to find x. We do it by undoing those two steps.
Think of an equation as a balance scale.
lines.alt: A level balance scale: 4 bags marked x and 7 cubes on the left, 35 cubes on the right; 7 cubes are crossed off each side

lines.say: The left side weighs the same as the right side.
If you take something off one side, it tips.
So whatever you do to one side, do to the other side.
Take 7 cubes off both sides. It still balances.
Now 4 bags balance 28 cubes.
Share 28 between 4 bags. Each bag is 7.
Undo the steps in reverse order. Last thing done, first thing undone.
Step 1. Get rid of the number that is added or subtracted.
Step 2. Get rid of the number that multiplies or divides x.
Plus or minus first. Times or divide second.
Write the equation.
Minus 11 is there. To undo minus 11, we add 11 to both sides.
That leaves 6x equals 24.
6 times x. To undo times 6, divide both sides by 6.
So x equals 4.
Now check. Put 4 back into the first equation.
One step per line. Keep the equals signs lined up.
Same steps, even when the numbers look odd.
Take 14 from both sides. 2 take away 14 is minus 12.
Divide both sides by 3.
Check it.
Here x is divided by 5, then 2 is added.
Plus 2 first. Take 2 from both sides.
Divided by 5. Undo it by multiplying both sides by 5.
Watch the brackets. In this one, all of x plus 4 is divided by 3.
So undo the divide first. Times both sides by 3.
Then take 4 from both sides.
Don't divide first. Undo the plus or minus first.
Don't change just one side. Say both sides out loud.
To undo minus 11, add 11. Not take away.
Careful with negatives. 2 take away 14 is minus 12, not 12.
Same to both sides.
Plus or minus first, times or divide second.
One step per line, with the equals signs lined up.
Always check your answer in the first equation.
